_comment: The ORFE-shaped mapping this pipeline was originally written against: the speaker sits in the ICS SUMMARY, the title is scraped from the event page, LOCATION reads '101 - Sherrerd Hall', and commas in the SUMMARY-derived field are re-escaped for the downstream ingester. Kept so the machinery tests (windowing, provenance, schema) exercise a shape that is not MAE's, and so the dash/escape code paths stay covered. MAE's live mapping is transform_config.json at the repo root.
